Statistics and Applied Probability
Statistics and Applied Probability
Established in 1989, the Department of Statistics and Applied Probability (PSTAT) at UCSB is a premier center for education and interdisciplinary research. Its 21 faculty members specialize in fields ranging from Data Science and Biostatistics to Theoretical Statistics. In response to growing demand for data analytics, the department has transitioned toward data-driven initiatives, playing a pivotal role in UCSB’s broader data science efforts and offering consulting via the DataLab.
PSTAT hosts the Center for Financial Mathematics and Actuarial Research (CFMAR) and holds the prestigious designation as California’s only Society of Actuaries Center of Actuarial Excellence. The department serves a massive student body, including over 2,000 undergraduates and 100 graduate students. Programs include diverse Bachelor’s degrees, an MA in Applied Statistics, and a PhD in Statistics and Applied Probability, with specialized emphases in Financial Mathematics and Quantitative Methods.
